quick_skim.title: Fixed-structure Gaussian Mixture Filtering with Robust Measurement Updates under Outliers
quick_skim.abstract: Bayesian state estimation for discrete-time nonlinear stochastic systems is considered in the presence of measurement outliers. Building on a fixed-structure Gaussian mixture filtering framework, this paper proposes a robust measurement-update variant in which the predictive density structure is determined by an offline decomposition of the transition density into axis-aligned Gaussian components. This construction maintains the Gaussian mixture structure as deterministic and tunable via the chosen decomposition fidelity. Measurement components affected by outliers are modeled using a Student's-t distribution, and the corresponding update of each Gaussian mixture component is approximated by a variational Bayes procedure. The resulting filter is evaluated in a three-dimensional tracking scenario with range and bearing measurements, where the bearing channel is affected by outliers, modeled as heavy-tailed noise.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Proposes robust fixed-structure Gaussian mixture filtering for nonlinear state estimation with outliers. Uses Student-t measurement updates via variational Bayes. Maintains deterministic mixture structure, improves outlier robustness, applicable to SOC estimation.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对非线性随机系统在测量异常值存在时的贝叶斯状态估计问题，本文提出一种固定结构高斯混合滤波的鲁棒测量更新方法。通过离线分解转移密度确定预测密度结构，并用学生t分布建模异常值，采用变分贝叶斯近似更新各分量。实验表明该方法在异常值环境下保持估计精度。该滤波框架可作为电池SOC估计中应对异常值的通用方法。
